title: Warm Bouncy Chinese Fenugreek Wonton Dumplings
description: Delicious, jammy, and energizing dumplings filled with fenugreek, served steamed with a savory soy-based dipping sauce. A great, low-carb-friendly Chinese dish perfect for a quick snack or lunch.
instructions: Combine fenugreek leaves, ground pork, green onions, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Mix all ingredients together until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a tablespoon of the filling in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In a large pot or steamer basket, arrange the dumplings in a single layer, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Cover the pot or steamer basket with a lid and steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10 minutes.
While the dumplings are steaming, prepare the dipping sauce by whisking together soy sauce and chicken broth in a small bowl.
Serve the dumplings hot with the dipping sauce on the side.
